title: $N$-Koszul algebras of finite global dimension for $N\geq 3$
summary: Let $N\geq 3$. The class of $N$-Koszul AS regular algebras, or more generally, that of $N$-Koszul AS Gorenstein algebras, has attracted much attention from algebraists. Nevertheless, there have been no known examples of $N$-Koszul AS regular algebras of finite global dimension other than the ones of global dimension $3$.
